tail:
brocc dont die auto loop all tasks with auto govener
Thoughts
Building a Termux/rish auto-loop with a governor that keeps tasks running and restarts on failure. Checking what's already in the repo. Creating an auto-governor and resilient agent loop (Termux/rish, harvest-first, self-healing). Broccoli don’t die = watchdog + agent_loop + auto_governor (Termux + rish, harvest-first, no send by default). Loop does not exit on errors; governor backs off and rotates tasks from meta/task_list.json.
Start (files already under ~/broccoli/lib + scripts/)
BASH
Copy
cd ~/broccoli && export PATH="$HOME/broccoli/bin:$PATH" BROCCOLI_ROOT="$PWD" PYTHONPATH="$PWD" && \
command -v rish >/dev/null || { termux-toast "Shizuku+rish"; exit 127; } && \
mkdir -p reports meta ui research data/harvest && \
bash scripts/broccoli_watchdog.sh restart && \
nohup bash scripts/broccoli_watchdog.sh run >> reports/watchdog.log 2>&1 & \
echo $! > reports/watchdog.pid && \
termux-toast "Broccoli: loop + governor ON" && \
brocc-loop status 2>/dev/null || bash scripts/broccoli_watchdog.sh status
Install loop bundle + start (one paste, ~7.5k — copy whole line from scripts/BROCC_DONT_DIE_ONELINER.sh on your tree)
# Mac: cd .../broccoli/scripts && python3 -m http.server 8765
cd ~/broccoli && mkdir -p scripts && \
curl -fsSL "http://YOUR_MAC_IP:8765/loop_bundle.tgz" -o scripts/loop_bundle.tgz && \
tar xzf scripts/loop_bundle.tgz -C . && chmod +x scripts/broccoli_watchdog.sh bin/brocc-loop lib/agent_loop.py && \
export PATH="$HOME/broccoli/bin:$PATH" BROCCOLI_ROOT="$PWD" PYTHONPATH="$PWD" && \
bash scripts/broccoli_watchdog.sh restart && nohup bash scripts/broccoli_watchdog.sh run >> reports/watchdog.log 2>&1 &
